method: Visual inspection of two previously decoded, source-time-labeled contact sheets. No audio was listened to. This is preliminary window screening, not full-frame track or speaker-association validation.

observations: Samples around 35–40, 59–62 and 83–87 seconds show a close image crop where the hands are outside the visible area. A missing hand measurement is appropriate for those windows.
Samples around 65–70 seconds show two seated people; the frozen preparation crop is needed to select one image region. A pose detection index by itself does not establish who is speaking.
The contact sheet includes camera-view transitions near the selected windows. Exact tail exclusions remain those in the original frame-screened measurement plan.
The selected one-person views generally include upper-body and wrist regions, making bounded wrist-geometry candidates plausible where model visibility checks also pass.
The 65–72 and 139–145 second samples include two seated people; cropping and a separate image-to-speaker review are required.
Visible mouth and head changes do not show whether laughter is audible or whether a movement is an intentional nod. Those annotation fields remain ungraded.
